final_selection.selection_rationale: Baseline remained selected after the mandatory second pretrained candidate completed. Validation label accuracy/macro-F1 were 0.9195/0.8441 for baseline, 0.6779/0.4433 for bert-tiny, and 0.8571/0.7532 for bert-mini. Minecraft gameplay BLOCK false-positive rates were 0.0182, 0.0909, and 0.0545 respectively. Both encoders reached 0.9636 real-world-threat BLOCK recall versus baseline 0.9273; baseline was retained because its overall validation quality and normal-gameplay false-positive profile were stronger.

thresholds.note: Unchanged provisional argmax/0.5 behavior. No threshold was retuned after frozen test, frozen-adversarial, or owner-golden results were observed.

contamination_statement: Training used W11 train only and candidate selection/calibration used validation only. Frozen test, frozen_adversarial, and owner_golden were opened before the mandatory second encoder comparison completed. The second encoder was subsequently trained on train and evaluated on validation only; the selected baseline, model parameters, preprocessing, and threshold behavior did not change. Those held-out results were not used to choose the final candidate and remain the one-time acceptance evidence for this unchanged model version. Any future candidate, model, preprocessing, or threshold change must treat the already-observed held-outs as development evidence and use a new/versioned unseen acceptance set.
